events.title: PubCrawl
events.description:
Expect a great night of music, drinks, socialising and good vibes as we move from venue to venue together. 🍻✨

🎟️ Ticket Prices
Early Bird — $5
General — $8
Final Release — $10

Your ticket gives you access to the event, plus exclusive links and offers available only to attendees. Please note that selected links may be unique to each ticket holder and should not be shared.

Get the ticket: https://events.humanitix.com/sudata-x-statsoc-x-pmsoc-x-suede-pubcrawl
